promoted_this_pass.reason: Restores tactile one-step wager control while preserving the canonical hidden select as the single bet authority.
HELIOS now has enough mechanics that a buyer/player needs one transparent current-mode rules surface.
Dim non-winning cells while paid hit cells and SVG trace stay emphasized. Presentation only.

not_promoted.reason: HELIOS is web-first and must open cleanly from a sales email on arbitrary browsers.
Public HELIOS uses demo presentation units and should not imply a live cashier or financial rail.
Outcome-shaping and near-miss timing are outside the HELIOS fairness contract.

remaining_real_gaps.reason: Children expose familiar Wild vocabulary, but HELIOS core currently evaluates exact left-to-right symbol equality. Do not label a symbol WILD until substitution exists in game math and tests.
HELIOS has the Solar Corona trigger, while DIVINE/GRIDJACK/CUSTOM do not yet expose distinct scatter/feature symbols.
Purchased free spins currently bridge into the existing balance-source spin core and refund bonus stakes in the presentation layer.
A partner should be able to configure branding, route, workload, music identity and presentation without reading source.

invariant: Promote universal safe primitives into HELIOS, preserve child identity, and never generalize legacy outcome-shaping, hidden compute, fake financial rails or compute-to-game coupling.
